test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which among the following statement is FALSE about transportation through phloem?

options.text: Transportation in phloem is by Utilization of energy (ATP)
Sucrose is transported initially by using energy into phloem
Increase in osmotic pressure due to sucrose causes water to move into phloem.
Transportation in phloem uses GTP & CTP

solution:
The correct answer is __**Transportation in phloem uses GTP & CTP**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The statement **"Transportation in phloem uses GTP & CTP" is false.**
 
• **Phloem transport uses energy in the form of ATP** to move materials like sucrose into the phloem tissue. 
 
• Phloem transport is a **process that moves food and other substances throughout a plant. **
 
• **The process of phloem transport is driven by osmotic pressure gradients** and active transport processes. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bcd8e8034bfd5ae25fc97b91c8158864ed2d032f5ac133c420f72554073391b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The primar**y sugar transported in phloem is sucrose, which is a non-reducing sugar. **
 
• Phloem transport is bidirectional, meaning it can transport nutrients in both upward and downward directions. 
 
• The** increase in osmotic pressure due to sucrose causes water to move into the phloem tissue**. 
 
• The pressure moves the material in the phloem to tissues which have less pressure. 
 
• Functions of plant tissues:__
 
 
• Plant tissues have different functions depending upon their structure and location
 
• Help provide mechanical strength to organs.
 
• They help in providing elasticity and flexibility to the organs.
 
• They help the tissues to bend easily in various parts of a plant like- leaf, stem, and branches without damaging the plant
 
• The xylem and phloem tissues help in the transportation of material throughout the plants
 
• They divide to produce new cells and help in the growth of the plants.
 
• They help in various cellular metabolisms like photosynthesis, regeneration, respiration, etc.
